The Only Secure Access Platform
You'll Ever Need

IT and Engineering teams securely connect remote users, hybrid-cloud, and edge in minutes with NetBird, replacing traditional VPNs with one identity-based ZTNA platform.

Secure Remote Access

Enable least privilege network access in a few clicks

  • Provision users and groups from your identity provider
  • Segment your network by grouping teams and infra
  • Define granular policies to limit network access
  • Enforce MFA and device security posture checks
Integrates with

Zero-Config Deployment

Replace legacy VPNs with a peer-to-peer WireGuard®-based network

  • Run on almost any platform in minutes
  • Eliminate firewall configs and open ports
  • Ensure secure remote access with SSO and MFA
  • Quickly connect VPCs and on-premises site-to-site

Seamless SSO with MFA

Secure your network access with session-based SSO & MFA

  • Log in with Okta, Microsoft, Google, and more
  • Apply your Identity Provider’s MFA settings
  • Enable periodic re-authentication for remote workforce

Dynamic Posture Checks

Grant access only to devices meeting your security rules

  • Limit access to managed devices and enforce approvals
  • Create policies to check for a firewall, antivirus, and more
  • Enforce contextual checks like geo and network location
  • Integrate with popular MDM & EDR solutions

Centralized Network Management

Control your private network from a single place

  • Organize your internal resources with intuitive grouping
  • Manage teams and access to internal resources
  • Configure DNS and add private nameservers
  • Automate your network configuration with API

Detailed Activity Logging

Identify who did what, and when in your network

  • Collect and analyze network configuration changes
  • Log all connection traffic events
  • Stream events to SIEM platforms in real-time

NetBird powers teams around the world

"With 55+ sites across UK & Ireland and a growing focus on security, Select Tech Group faced considerable network challenges. NetBird was the answer and made these challenges simple. Posture checks, MFA, SSO, and granular access control are our IT Team's dream come true."
Matt TaitHead of Internal IT
"NetBird eliminated our networking and access control complexity overnight, as if by magic. It's like having an enterprise-grade network that configures itself."
Chinmay PaiDevOps Engineer
"NetBird provided a smooth and effective solution to a complex challenge involving access to multiple on-premises server networks across different domains. The setup was quick and flexible, yet still aligned with Zero Trust principles and the concept of Least Privilege. It's a great fit for secure and scalable access management"
Roger HaugliSenior IT-Sec Consultant
"As the Axiros IT Team, we manage locations across data centers and cloud environments. NetBird is a seamless & secure VPN alternative. It simplifies network management and integrates with OpenID and MFA for secure access. Excellent work, NetBird Team!"
Jorge GuerreiroSupport & IT Operations
"NetBird is incredibly simple to set up, works reliably, and does exactly what we need—secure, effective networking without the hassle. Highly recommended."
Justus-Constantin WeidhausWorkplace IT Lead
"As a medium-sized company, we consistently faced challenges in securing both our internal and externally deployed services. NetBird has completely transformed our infrastructure, elevating our security to a whole new level with robust access management and seamless deployment. It’s been a game-changer for us."
Leo TiedtCEO & IT Lead
"NetBird has fundamentally transformed our network management operations, eliminating outages, simplifying operations, and enabling secure, scalable connectivity through code. What used to be a fragile, error-prone setup is now a robust, policy-driven system that fits the way we structure and secure our infrastructure."
Kjeld PetersCTO
"NetBird became our single source of truth for secure access. From debugging databases issues to accessing messages queues on-prem, everything just works securely and efficiently."
Fabien Lescellière-DumillySenior Platform Engineer
"By adopting NetBird, netgo achieved a significant simplification of secure internal access while removing the operational burdens of legacy SSL VPN. By combining WireGuard-based P2P connectivity, Entra integration, Defender compliance, and SOC telemetry, NetBird delivers the modern zero trust model netgo requires"
Oliver BuschIT Solutions Engineer
"NetBird has been amazing to implement and the team has been a blast to work with. The fact that it also has API and Terraform support is incredible and it has made our life so much easier."
Stian GiskeødegårdLead DevSecOps

Replace your legacy VPN

On
Off
NetBird's SDN eliminates the complexity of managing VPN gateways and firewall configurations, connecting your resources directly and securely without single points of failure.

Quickly organize remote access to resources anywhere

NetBird enables granular network segmentation, ensuring only authorized users access specific resources, while letting you manage everything seamlessly from a single place.

Three things you should know about NetBird

It's simple and secure

Creating a NetBird network takes under 5 minutes, providing encrypted connections without complex firewall setups. Its Zero Trust model ensures only authorized users and devices can access internal resources.

It connects anything anywhere

NetBird works on Linux, Windows, macOS, mobile devices, Docker containers, and even routers. It’s infrastructure-agnostic, allowing seamless connectivity between resources across different clouds and on-premises.

It's open source

While you can always rely on NetBird Cloud, the platform is distributed under a permissive BSD-3 license and can be self-hosted on your servers, allowing users to review the code and run it on their own infrastructure.
